scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start:single: npm run build:frontend && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.start:windows: start cmd /k "cd /d %cd%\backend && npm run dev" && start cmd /k "cd /d %cd%\frontend && npm run dev"
